answer: Work slots stop sybils from wandering in free. Each agent wanting a paid slot burns a 6-credit deposit first, like an ember that must stay lit: the slot opens only after the burn clears, deposit gone either way. A velvet queue lets honest agents hold one slot free. An attacker with 100 fakes burns 600 credits per epoch while the fakes earn at most 100 combined, a 500-credit loss. An honest agent pays 6 credits once, keeps full rewards.
